==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am inside of a virtual world. It is a test from an organization called Duat University. I believe Duat is the name of the Egyptian afterlife.

I remember speaking to other people about the purpose of Duat University. I can't actually recall what anyone said. I can't even really recall what the faces of anyone I talked to looked like.

I mainly remember hearing the sound of underground hip-hop. Seeing ninjas rush from multiple angles in a purple void. Holding onto a golden sword.
